items.mainDefect: The Salesforce connection uses the old access token and instance URL despite obtaining refreshed credentials.

secondary.defect: The old refresh token is persisted and passed to jsforce even when the manual refresh may have rotated it, breaking subsequent refreshes.

items.mainDefect: The schema's computed keys fail to define an index signature, causing token expiry fields to be stripped.

secondary.defect: A literal "refresh_token" placeholder is persisted instead of preserving the real refresh token.

items.mainDefect: The sharing-mode schema's computed keys cause fields other than access_token, including expiry, to be stripped.

secondary.defect: Injecting the literal "refresh_token" when the response omits one overwrites the real stored refresh token.

items.mainDefect: Invalid webhook request bodies cause uncaught schema-validation exceptions and return 500 responses.

secondary.defect: Invalid encrypted keys cause uncaught decryption or JSON-parsing exceptions and return 500 responses.
